<thought>Using the most intense ESI‑MS peak at m/z 211.0764 as the [M+H]⁺ ion, subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~210.0691 Da. The formula C₁₄H₁₀O₂ matches this exact mass within 1 mDa (calculated neutral mass 210.0681 Da), making it the best candidate.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H10O2</final_answer>
